# inspect last transition details for SPACE
bt = last_transition.before_frame.segmentation['nodes']
at = current_frame.segmentation['nodes']
def map_by_id(nodes):
    return {n['id']:n for n in nodes}
bm = map_by_id(bt)
am = map_by_id(at)
# find nodes that moved or changed
changed_ids = []
for nid, a in am.items():
    b = bm.get(nid)
    if not b:
        changed_ids.append(('new', nid))
    elif b['color']!=a['color'] or b['pixels']!=a['pixels'] or b['hash']!=a['hash'] or b['boundary']!=a['boundary']:
        changed_ids.append(('changed', nid, b['color'], a['color']))
print('changed ids', changed_ids[:30])
# list all nodes with color N,p,b,Y at top and bottom
top_colors = {}
bottom_colors = {}
for n in at:
    if n['boundary'][0][0]<=6:
        top_colors.setdefault(n['color'], []).append(n['id'])
    if n['boundary'][0][0]>=55:
        bottom_colors.setdefault(n['color'], []).append(n['id'])
print('top', top_colors)
print('bottom', bottom_colors)
# inspect white selector nodes
whites = [n for n in at if n['color']=='W']
print('whites', [(n['id'], n['boundary']) for n in whites])
# inspect red rectangle and its children
red = [n for n in at if n['color']=='R'][0]
print('red children', red['children'])
# find node id 13 (inside red)
n13 = am.get(13)
print('node13', n13)
# list gray slots inside red
gray_slots = [n for n in at if n['color']=='g' and n['pixels']==4]
print('gray slots', [(n['id'], n['boundary']) for n in gray_slots])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
